dropzones.name: Birr Aerodrome
dropzones.status_evidence: Public 2026 instructor recruitment and a directory identify a Birr operation, but actual commencement of regular jumps was not verified.

sources.what: Public employer recruitment listing for Birr instructors.
Directory names SkydiveThru at Birr Airfield.
Operator homepage opened; only title readable.

dropzones.note: Launch lead; recruitment is not proof of operational status. Airport article coordinates match Birr, although its GeoHack label incorrectly says Bantry.

dropzones.name: Donegal Airport
dropzones.status_evidence: AirNav Ireland AIP ENR 5.5 valid 11 June 2026 lists IPC parachuting at Donegal during summer months only.

sources.what: 2026 AIP lists operator, summer season and airport-centred coordinates.

dropzones.note: AIP designation supports seasonal use; no dated operator 2026 Donegal event calendar was found. Confirm actual operating dates before use.

dropzones.name: Kilkenny Airport
dropzones.status_evidence: January 2026 local reporting describes upheld grounding/licence enforcement; June 2026 AIP still lists parachuting here. Resumption of regular jumps was not verified.

sources.what: 7 January 2026 report of court decision and disrupted bookings.
2026 AIP retains this designated parachuting site.

dropzones.note: Do not treat an AIP designation or a live contact page as evidence that suspended flights restarted.
